# lean-pkg index check

static check, or re-derive entries from bytes at the pin; exit 0/1/2.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg index check [--clone] [--repo DIR] [--index INDEX] [--json] [NAME ...]
```

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--clone` | clone each entry's repo at the pin into a temp dir |
| `--repo DIR` | local clone for a single NAME (never modified) (old spelling --repo-dir, kept working) |
| `--index INDEX` | index root (default: $LEAN_PKG_INDEX, else index/ beside the registry when present, else ./index) |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `index check [NAME ...]` | index root: `--index`, else env `LEAN_PKG_INDEX`, else `index/` beside the registry when present, else `./index`; `check`, `render` and `migrate` exit 1 with `no index at <path>` when it is missing (`render` creates it only for an explicit `--index` or `--out`). Static checks, or re-derive each entry from bytes at the pin and recompute trust and the conditional claim keys (`status`, `open_hypotheses`; [Conditional claims](../index-catalog.md#conditional-claims)); Palomar and Reservoir verified when reachable, else skipped; the summary `N entries checked: all pass\|FAILED` comes before the per-entry lines and again last; exit 0, 1 or 2 | `[--clone]` `[--repo DIR]` `[--index PATH]` |

## Exit codes

Exit 1 is also a negative answer here:

- `index check`: an entry fails its checks / README.md is stale

## Examples

Statically check every entry (schema, receipt copies, trust, duplicates), printing the verdict before and after the per-entry lines; exit 0 all pass, 1 any failure, 2 a usage error.

```bash
lean-pkg index check
```

Sample output:

```text
3 entries checked: all pass
PASS gromov-filling-lean (comparator)
  note: static check only: pass --clone (or --repo) to re-derive from bytes
PASS markovprocess-pilot (comparator)
  note: static check only: pass --clone (or --repo) to re-derive from bytes
PASS total-coloring-lean (comparator)
  note: static check only: pass --clone (or --repo) to re-derive from bytes
3 entries checked: all pass
```

Clone the entry's repository at the pin into a temporary directory, re-derive its receipts, toolchain, license, tag and headline files from those bytes and recompute trust; Palomar and Reservoir are verified when reachable, else reported as skipped.

```bash
lean-pkg index check --clone my-proof
```

The same re-derivation from a local clone of one package, which is never modified.

```bash
lean-pkg index check my-proof --repo ../my-proof
```
